description: Defines the EmpEmergencyContactService class which provides methods for managing employee emergency contact data, including retrieval, saving, deletion, and search functionalities within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: EmpEmergencyContactService
classes.description: A service class providing CRUD and search operations for employee emergency contact information within the OrangeHRM HRM system.

methods.name: getEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Returns the current instance of EmpEmergencyContactDao, instantiating it if necessary.

methods.name: setEmpEmergencyContactDao
methods.description: Sets the EmpEmergencyContactDao instance to be used by this service.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContact
methods.description: Retrieves a specific emergency contact for a given employee based on employee number and sequence number.

methods.name: getEmployeeEmergencyContactList
methods.description: Retrieves all emergency contacts for a specified employee.

methods.name: saveEmpEmergencyContact
methods.description: Saves or updates an employee emergency contact record.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Deletes specified emergency contact entries for an employee; if no entries are specified, deletes all contacts for that employee.

methods.name: searchEmployeeEmergencyContacts
methods.description: Returns a list of emergency contacts matching the provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getSearchEmployeeEmergencyContactsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of emergency contacts matching the search filter parameters.
